about: Server state of a falling entity (jumps, shoves, falls; born with ecl::jump Takeoff/Land events and ecl::Projectile). Created and updated by esv::FallingSystem (LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted, UpdateFallingComponents, ProcessStopFallingRequest, DamageHitEntities, ForceOnImpact). macOS AddComponent<esv::falling::DataComponent, float, eoc::spell::SpellId, EAbility, bool, EntityHandle> names the constructor arguments.

evidence.says: EoCServer.dll+0x669DF0 LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted: eoc::ActionOriginator::operator=(component, ActionOriginator(Guid::Generate())). Equals SE ActionOriginator. Live: random Guid, three null FixedStrings, byte 1.

LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted: if the request's handle at +0x50 is valid it is stored at component+0x20 (last AddComponent argument, ls::ID<EntityHandleTraits>; the debug log prints it as 'Source'). macOS default null handle.
SpellId::operator=(component+0x28, request+8); equals SE eoc::spell::SpellId (0x38 bytes).
component+0x60 = request byte +0x40, the EAbility argument of the macOS AddComponent signature (SE enum AbilityId, 1 byte here). macOS default 0.
macOS default zero (stur q1 at +0x68); live always 0; not seen written.

LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted clears component+0x78 (EoCServer.dll+0x226330) and inserts the group characters of the faller when the spell prototype has flag 4 (EoCServer.dll+0x21E210 = HashSet<EntityHandle> insert). Live: bucket pointer and count 5, key/next arrays with 1 element in 4 of 48 instances. Name is a guess (entities excluded from/handled by the fall damage).

DamageHitEntities (EoCServer.dll+0x668AE0) computes (StartHeight - current height) + this; ForceOnImpact (EoCServer.dll+0x669B30) also reads it: an extra fall distance. Live 0. | Name: DamageHitEntities (EoCServer.dll+0x668AE0) computes (StartHeight - current height) + this value as the fall height; ForceOnImpact (EoCServer.dll+0x669B30) reads it too.
UpdateFallingComponents (EoCServer.dll+0x66C470) adds GetDeltaTimeForEntity to +0xAC every frame and aborts the fall when MaxFallTime <= it. Live 0.
Compared with FallTime; assert text 'has been falling for longer than %.2f seconds and will now be aborted' prints it. Live always FLT_MAX (macOS default d8).
LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted keeps the larger of the old and new start height at +0xB4 ('Start Height' in its log). Live 0.22..10.07.
= request byte +0x48 (the bool argument of AddComponent). macOS default 1; live 0/1.

UpdateFallingComponents logs 'Update deferred removal' when set; ProcessStopFallingRequest (EoCServer.dll+0x66BA70) prints it as 'Deferred: %s' and only stops falling when 0. LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted clears +0xB9/+0xBA.
Cleared together with +0xB9 by LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted (uint16 store).

Set to 1 by LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted; when set, ProcessStopFallingRequest calls DamageHitEntities and ForceOnImpact on landing (apply impact). macOS default 1. | Name: Set to 1 by LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted; when set, ProcessStopFallingRequest calls DamageHitEntities and ForceOnImpact on landing.

survey.names_pass_2: Two members named from the Toolkit falling system (LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted, ProcessStopFallingRequest); Osiris Falling(_Entity, _Cause) carries nothing new.
open_questions: role of the entity set at +0x78
field_B8 is the bool argument of AddComponent in the macOS signature; the caller of LEGACY_RequestFallingStarted would name it.
